title: 2001 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 4
statement:
Find \(a+b+c+d+e\) if

\[\begin{gathered}
3 a+2 b+4 d=10, \\
6 a+5 b+4 c+3 d+2 e=8, \\
a+b+2 c+5 e=3, \\
2 c+3 d+3 e=4, \text { and } \\
a+2 b+3 c+d=7 .
\end{gathered}\]

solutions.text: Adding the first, third, and fifth equations, we get \(5 a+5 b+5 c+5 d+5 e=\) \(10+3+7 \Rightarrow a+b+c+d+e=4\).
